profiles.rule: Preserve V16 geometry and relaxation. Before the unchanged speed clamp, subtract 0.5 times each measured joint velocity from its position-error velocity request. Require valid finite measured velocities. Do not alter observations, standing gates, impulse caps, timeouts or get-up commands.
profiles.parameter_basis: Prospective dimensionless half-strength opposing velocity feedback, not a fitted optimum. Retained V16 late body motion is mainly along the hip axis and strongly covaries with hip velocity. A one-step ideal velocity-following recurrence is checked for decay with this gain at the existing 120 Hz and 0.1 s relaxation; that toy model excludes contacts, torque saturation and native solver dynamics and proves no physical stability or recovery.
